notes.title: Patch: Updated Menus
notes.notes: [p]Patch Notes:[/p][list][*][p]Improved readability and navigation on settings and cosmetics menus. Now they should be easier to read, and should be properly navigable when using the controller or keyboard only[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that broke the Mouse Only control style, for all of the three people who use it[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the jitter on title screen backgrounds[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes: [p]I rewrote the saving system, but your save data should be automatically migrated to the new system the next time you open the game.[/p][p]Other changes:[/p][list][*][p]Redesigned the first area: Added water, reflections, terrain, trees, and some other things far off into the distance. Occasionally a group of butterflies will spawn on the stage, and you can chase them away.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a visual indicator to the pull teammate effect[/p][/*][*][p]Added partial support for ultrawide and portrait aspect ratios[/p][/*][*][p]Added a place indicator sign to race mode, though it doesn't track your progress through the level yet[/p][/*][*][p]Launching the game for the first time should now automatically set the locale to your native language[/p][/*][*][p]Added controller vibrations when you bounce[/p][/*][*][p]Added a stage tilt setting[/p][/*][/list][p]Bugfixes/Tweaks:[/p][list][*][p]Other players in race mode should have nameplates now[/p][/*][*][p]In race mode, other players should no longer be invisible or in the wrong spot[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the look of triplanar materials, there shouldn't be any ugly blending on curved surfaces now[/p][/*][*][p]Altered the raindrops shader in the first environment to be much less performance intensive[/p][/*][*][p]The minimap button is no longer double bound to the reverse camera button[/p][/*][*][p]Hiding the UI should now properly hide all UI elements[/p][/*][*][p]Hiding the UI no longer hides the pause menu[/p][/*][/list]
